input.source_layout: Reference filenames in T-202/crops. Current source in T-202/sheets, zero-based row, crop [1000,128+1064*row,2000,1128+1064*row].

coordinates: Top-left origin; x right, y down; points in 400 units per square tile. F = max right cheek x - min left cheek x over traced face outline, H = chin y - main hair crown y (exclude bun).
gap: current minus fixed reference target; tolerance is symmetric. M = measured; E = inferred or estimated; null = unavailable.

head_roundness.protocol: F/H. Projected aspect of the head; exclude ears, bun and peripheral locks from F.

cheek_width.protocol: Skin contour width midway down from near iris centre to chin / F.

jaw_width.protocol: Skin contour width at 80% of near iris-to-chin fall / F.

chin_width.protocol: Skin contour width at 93% of near iris-to-chin fall / F.

chin_height.protocol: Vertical mouth-box centre to chin / H.

eye_width.protocol: Horizontal visible opening width inside lash / H, image-left or near eye.

eye_height.protocol: Vertical visible opening height inside lash / H, image-left or near eye.

eye_y.protocol: Near iris-centre depth below the main crown / H.

eye_to_chin.protocol: Vertical near iris-centre to chin / H. Usable in profile.

eye_x.protocol: Signed near iris-centre x from cheek-span midpoint / F, image right positive.

eye_spacing.protocol: Image-plane distance between iris centres / F. Foreshortened on turns.

iris_size.protocol: Horizontal visible iris diameter / H. Estimate exposed arc when lid clips it.

opening_h_w.protocol: Height / width of the visible opening inside lash.

iris_d_w.protocol: Horizontal iris diameter / visible opening width.

iris_d_spacing.protocol: Horizontal iris diameter / distance between iris centres.

brow_gap.protocol: Lower edge of brow at pupil x to opening top / H; if using opposite brow, set brow_lid.

nose_width.protocol: Width of the visible nose mound (tip and wings, excluding cast shadow) / F.

nose_height.protocol: Visible nose mound height / H. Soft shading makes boundaries estimates.

nose_y.protocol: Nose mound box centre below main crown / H.

mouth_width.protocol: Lip or closed-seam corner separation / F.

mouth_height.protocol: Bounding height of visible lip/seam, including aperture if open / H.

mouth_y.protocol: Mouth box centre below main crown / H.

mouth_x.protocol: Mouth box centre x from cheek-span midpoint / F, image right positive.

hair_width.protocol: Projected outer hair span above iris line (incl bun, excl accessories) / F.

hair_height.protocol: Chin to highest hair including buns / H. Null for clipped bun.

cheek_bulge.protocol: Signed forward distance of mid-slice skin from chord joining eye-level and 85%-slice anterior skin points / H. Both lower slices use eye to chin as vertical interval.

cheek_advance.protocol: Mid-slice anterior skin x minus eye-level anterior skin x, signed forward / H.

exposed_cheek.protocol: Uninterrupted visible skin from the front contour to the first ear or lock at the mid-slice / H. If contour is hidden, measure the exposed skin window between locks (visibility only).

ear_width.protocol: Visible front near pinna width / bare face width F; trace from outer rim to root (estimate root if covered).

ear_height.protocol: Visible vertical pinna extent / crown-to-chin Hh, excluding buns but including hairstyle crown.

ear_top_eye.protocol: Ear top y minus iris-centre y / Hh (positive down).

ear_base_mouth.protocol: Lobule bottom y minus mouth centre y / Hh.

ear_turn_projection.protocol: Near ear extension beyond local cheek contour at ear mid-height / projected face width. Ignore the hair contour.

crown_above_skull.protocol: Highest main hair tip (exclude buns) above inferred smooth skull apex / Hh. Skull apex reconstructed by eye from temporal curvature.

forehead_covered.protocol: On facial midline, length of inferred skull-apex to brow interval covered by hair / full interval (cap at 1).

fringe_eye.protocol: Iris-centre y minus centreline fringe-tip y / Hh. Positive means fringe ends above eyes.

hair_cheek_width.protocol: Outermost hair-to-hair distance at y midway between pupils and mouth / F. Enter 0 if no hair crosses this line.

bun_width.protocol: Outer width of one bun / F (auburn whole knot, white image-left bun). Zero for absent.

cheek_L.protocol: D65 sRGB appearance, L* from median RGB in a 3.5/400 tile-radius disk at cheek.

cheek_a.protocol: D65 sRGB appearance, a* from median RGB in a 3.5/400 tile-radius disk at cheek.

cheek_b.protocol: D65 sRGB appearance, b* from median RGB in a 3.5/400 tile-radius disk at cheek.

forehead_L.protocol: D65 sRGB appearance, L* from median RGB in a 3.5/400 tile-radius disk at forehead.

forehead_a.protocol: D65 sRGB appearance, a* from median RGB in a 3.5/400 tile-radius disk at forehead.

forehead_b.protocol: D65 sRGB appearance, b* from median RGB in a 3.5/400 tile-radius disk at forehead.

bow_L.protocol: D65 sRGB appearance, L* from median RGB in a 3.5/400 tile-radius disk at bow.

bow_a.protocol: D65 sRGB appearance, a* from median RGB in a 3.5/400 tile-radius disk at bow.

bow_b.protocol: D65 sRGB appearance, b* from median RGB in a 3.5/400 tile-radius disk at bow.

blush_da.protocol: Blushed cheek a* minus adjacent unblushed cheek a* under the same light.
